trust_model.server_authored_only: Clients cannot supply arbitrary trigger=USER_AUTHORIZED. The scope must be instantiated by validated server endpoints with non-empty, non-anonymous authenticated_principal.
trust_model.monotonic_ttl: Each scope has an immutable monotonic start timestamp (time.monotonic()) and bounded TTL (default 300s). Expired contexts are immediately blocked by check_outbound_authorization.
trust_model.async_isolation: Context is stored in Python contextvars (ContextVar), preventing cross-talk between concurrent async sessions.
trust_model.thread_adapter: Worker threads can inherit context using run_with_inference_context(ctx, fn) or @propagate_inference_context.
